summary: Provides a filtered list of students specific to a particular course or class, primarily designed for class teachers to view only their assigned students.
steps: The system will automatically display students relevant to the user's assigned course or class.
business_rules: A class teacher will only have access to view students from their assigned class or course.
important_notes: This feature is intended to provide restricted data visibility, ensuring that teachers only see students relevant to their responsibilities.
The 'Student List' (general) contains complete data for all students, whereas 'Student List Course Wise' is filtered.
questions: How can a class teacher view only the students in their class?
What is the main purpose of the 'Student List Course Wise' feature?
Does 'Student List Course Wise' show all student data or only specific data?
Where can I find a list of students for a particular course?
